notes.title: Now Recruiting Pilots For Multiplayer Testing! [READ MORE]
notes.content:
This is a huge opportunity to be working with real game dev professionals as we add new content to the Rocket Armor game. As one of our upcoming milestones, we're adding multiplayer experiences for the community. In order to do that well... we need official players who we can give out exclusive demos before anyone else.


All you need in order to get exclsive access to early multiplayer:

[olist]
[*] Purchase the game to be selected as one of our multiplayer pilots
[*] have a steady internet connection
[*] High availability so we can test and get immediate feedback
[*] be very critical and passionate about online games to discuss features
[*] love playing video games
[/olist]


Get Ready!
